Wolverhampton racecourse: what to look out for 🏇 A cheat sheet for Friday night racing under the lights.

We went through 4,739 all-weather races at Wolverhampton since 2019. Over 5f, low stalls won 14% of the time and high stalls 9%. Horses held up at the back over 5f won about 1 time in 17. And a 20/1 shot or bigger wins about 1 race in 22.

Save this before Friday night at Wolverhampton.

It's from the work behind our Wolverhampton Track DNA guide, coming soon. Make finding a winner a little easier.

Low draw or front-runner: which matters more at Wolverhampton, and why? 👇

Data: Wolverhampton all-weather Flat, Jan 2019 to Oct 2026, ZANS results database.
